cases.name: Madeline Spatafore
cases.about: According to her LinkedIn profile, she was a neurocritical care physician assistant at UPMC Presbyterian in Pittsburgh, PA. She graduated from high school in 2019, and then graduated summa cum laude from Duquesne University with a degree in health services in 2023. She was part of several prestigious extracurricular activities, including the professional health honor society Pi Kappa Epsilon. She was also the academic chair of her sorority, Delta Zeta.
cases.narrative: He reportedly called his parents and told them he killed her, then committed suicide.
